title: Chicken and Bacon Shish Kabobs
description: Marinated mushrooms and bacon-wrapped chicken chunks are threaded onto skewers with pineapple, and cooked on the grill.
ingredients: 3 skinless, boneless chicken breast halves - cut into chunks
0.5 pound sliced thick cut bacon, cut in half

steps.text: In a large bowl, mix the soy sauce, cider vinegar, honey, canola oil, and green onions. Place the mushrooms and chicken into the mixture, and stir to coat. Cover, and marinate in the refrigerator at least 1 hour.

Remove the mushrooms and chicken from the marinade and shake off excess. Pour the marinade into a small saucepan and bring to a boil over high heat. Reduce heat to medium-low and simmer for 10 minutes; set aside.
Wrap the chicken chunks with bacon, and thread onto skewers so that the bacon is secured. Alternate with mushroom halves and pineapple chunks.
Lightly oil the grill grate. Arrange skewers on the prepared grill. Cook 15 to 20 minutes, brushing occasionally with remaining soy sauce mixture, until bacon is crisp and chicken juices run clear.

video.description: Summer’s the season of shish kabobbing, so what are you waiting for? Make a simple and tangy marinade of soy sauce, cider vinegar, honey, green onion and canola oil, then drop in chunks of chicken breast and halved mushrooms to marinate. When everything’s had a good soak and your grill is hot, remove the marinade and reduce it over high heat into a sauce. Wrap chicken in bacon and skewer with mushrooms and pineapple chunks. Grill and brush with sauce and serve when irresistibly done!
video.name: Chicken and Bacon Shish Kabobs
